page_title: GET 2-0 OVI | Getafe v Oviedo 13/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+8' The Getafe players are exchanging some short passes.
90+6' R. Oviedo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+6' Getafe take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+5' Yvan Neyou (Getafe) is booked.
90+2' It will be a substitution. Coba da Costa (Getafe) is ready to enter the pitch as Adrian Liso walks off.
90+2' A yellow card for a tackle by Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo). Jose Guzman doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+1' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+1' Adrian Liso (Getafe) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Getafe.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Adrian Liso (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
89' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Getafe.
89' Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe) is yellow-carded.
86' The Getafe players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
85' The attendance is 8657.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mario Martin as he is replaced by Yvan Neyou (Getafe).
84' Total attempts – 10:3.
80' Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) is shown a red card by the referee for chasing his opponent and bringing him down with a very nasty tackle!
80' Leander Dendoncker (R. Oviedo) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Federico Vinas (R. Oviedo) was quite harsh and Jose Guzman didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
79' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jose Guzman shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Veljko Paunovic (R. Oviedo) is the recipient.
78' Substitution. David Carmo (R. Oviedo) in, David Costas out.
77' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
73' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Abdel Abqar limps off the pitch to be replaced by Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe).
72' 48:52 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
70' Referee Jose Guzman has finally had enough of Veljko Paunovic and brandishes a yellow card at him!
70' Abu Kamara (Getafe) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' Today's match ends for Borja Mayoral who will be replaced by Abu Kamara (Getafe).
67' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) replacing Kiko Femenia.
65' The injury to Kiko Femenia (Getafe) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
65' The game has come to an end for Javi Lopez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Rahim Alhassane (R. Oviedo).
59' Lucas Ahijado (R. Oviedo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Guzman had an easy-decision to make.

58' Veljko Paunovic has decided to substitute Alberto Reina and he is replaced by Santiago Colombatto (R. Oviedo).
58' Substitution. Josip Brekalo walks off the pitch and Santi Cazorla (R. Oviedo) comes on as a substitute.
52' Jose Guzman shows a yellow card to Dani Calvo (R. Oviedo) for his blatant foul.
52' Luka Ilic (R. Oviedo) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
51' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from R. Oviedo was in an offside position.
48' Luis Milla (Getafe) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
47' Mario Martin (Getafe) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
46' Half-time substitution. Jose Bordalas Jimenez decided to make a change. Djene (Getafe) is replaced by Davinchi.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+14' The end of the first half.
45+13' Neat passing move from Getafe in order to create new attacking opportunities.
45+9' 2 - 0 Borja Mayoral (Getafe) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 2:0.
45+9' Getafe force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45+7' OFF THE BAR! Alberto Reina (R. Oviedo) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
45+6' Josip Brekalo (R. Oviedo) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
45+4' 1 - 0 GOAL! Luis Milla curls the free kick into the box. Mario Martin (Getafe) peels off his marker and arrows a brilliant header past Aaron Escandell and into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
45+3' It seemed like Luis Milla (Getafe) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45+2' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

31' Getafe are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
29' Dani Calvo (R. Oviedo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Guzman saw the whole situation.
28' Adrian Liso (Getafe) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
25' The ratio of the ball possession is 38:62.
22' Alex Fores (R. Oviedo) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
21' There's a distinct lack of options for Abdel Abqar (Getafe), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post.
19' Haissem Hassan (R. Oviedo) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
16' Nacho Vidal is unable to continue after that nasty looking head injury. Veljko Paunovic ushers on Lucas Ahijado (R. Oviedo) to replace him.
9' Diego Rico (Getafe) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' The game is interrupted. Nacho Vidal (R. Oviedo) suffers a horrific injury!

7' The R. Oviedo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
